content:
Leah: Onboarding for PaperTrail hit weird 429s despite low traffic. They report bursts right after deploys and CI test runs. Can someone take a look?
Tom: pattern sounds like token churn + client clock drift. If clients think token expired earlier they all refresh at once. Also CI runners create lots of short-lived connections from many IPs which trips IP-based shaping.
Ravi: they use 50s TTL and client-side clock is ~12s fast. So at ~38s app thinks token expired and refreshes frequently. Quick mitigations: accept some TTL leeway client-side (refresh only after 80% TTL), add jitter to refresh windows, and mark CI runners with x-client-id so we can apply different shaping.
Leah: sample change we suggested to devs:
```js
function needsRefresh(token){
  const age = Date.now()/1000 - token.iat;
  return age > token.ttl * 0.8 + (Math.random()*5); // splay 0-5s
}
```
Leah: also told them to avoid refresh on every test job; instead reuse a session token cached in CI for the job lifetime.
Customer-Eng: we patched CI to set header `x-client-type: ci-job` and reused token for job. That grouped requests.
Tom: ops option: temporary soft-capacity (12h) and a relaxed per-client window for new x-client-ids. @OnboardBot can you open a temp-cap ticket?
OnboardBot: Created ticket #PTRL-ONB-07 for 12h soft warmup, owner: Tom, ETA: 45m.
Ravi: also recommended server-side: accept slight clock skew by honoring token TTL with a small grace on server (e.g., +15s) for preflight validation when client provides x-client-id. This reduces accidental fanout during minor clock drift.
Leah: after client TTL-leeway + CI header we saw 429s drop from ~120/min to ~8/min within 10 minutes. Logs: [2026-07-02T15:11:02Z] preflight papertrail-ci 200; [2026-07-02T15:11:20Z] preflight papertrail-web 429; [2026-07-02T15:11:46Z] preflight papertrail-web 200 retry.
Tom: CS handoff checklist to message customer: ["apply client TTL leeway (80%)","add jitter to refresh","cache token in CI jobs","set x-client-id/x-client-type in requests","ops temp warmup ticket PTRL-ONB-07","monitor dashboard 2h with owner Tom"].
Leah: I'll send the checklist and offer a tiny SDK helper to opt-in TTL-splay for clients. Closing after 2h stable confirmation. :white_check_mark:
